description.summary: You play a song of the elements, bestowing your allies with a resistance to elemental spells and effects.
description.value: You play a song of the elements, bestowing your allies with a resistance to elemental spells and effects. The bard chooses an element type: dark, earth, fire, ice, light, lightning, water, or wind. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +2 morale bonus to Saving Throws against the elemental (of the chosen type) spells and effects as well as an Elemental (of the chosen type) Resistance of 5.
